A clear, close-up photo of the image sensor without the body cap.
A video showing the camera powering on, the LCD working, and a photo being taken.
A single photo showing the camera body next to the batteries, charger, and trigger.

Photo of the sensor with the body cap removed

response.reason: The identity of the camera is confirmed by the witness. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state as a body-only unit until the accessories and shutter health are verified.
